name: Print Mat
description: Complete photo framing toolkit: canvas system, photo scale, crop ratios, mat + matte bevel, frame styles + ratio, sharp/rounded/circle corners, directional frame & internal shadows with Match Lighting, 7 procedural textures, EXIF captions with per-field language/locale control and per-component show/hide toggles (date/time, aperture/shutter/ISO), auto-stacking when multiple captions share a position, live Develop preview, save/reset defaults.
author: OPGERUIMD97
